label: Designing Data-Intensive Applications

key_mental_models.name: Linearizability vs Serializability

core_chapters.title: Storage and Retrieval
core_chapters.takeaway: LSM-trees optimize for write throughput by appending to memtable and flushing SSTables; B-trees optimize for read latency.

core_chapters.title: Replication
core_chapters.takeaway: Handling node outages, replication lag, monotonic reads, and consistent prefix reads across replicas.

core_chapters.title: Consistency and Consensus
core_chapters.takeaway: Total order broadcast is equivalent to distributed consensus; solving consensus enables atomic commit and distributed locks.
